firm_data.firm_description: Baughman Kroup Bosse PLLC is a litigation boutique that handles complex civil, criminal, and regulatory matters. The firm represents clients in courts nationwide and worldwide.
notable_facts: Formerly known as JFB Legal, relaunched as Baughman Kroup Bosse PLLC on January 1, 2024.
The firm has offices in New York City and Norfolk.
BKB celebrated four years of service in 2024, growing from a single attorney to a boutique with 18 attorneys.

email.subject: AI for Baughman Kroup Bosse, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jack,

Congrats on the relaunch as Baughman Kroup Bosse PLLC. Moving from JFB Legal to your current footprint across New York and Norfolk while handling complex civil and criminal litigation nationwide shows real momentum.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
